title: Local DVR cohomology normal form and its consecutive-quotient Tor obstruction
statement: Let T be a noetherian scheme of bounded Krull dimension, l invertible in all its stalks, and E/Q_l a finite extension. For any bounded constructible intrinsically complete complex K for the actual unlifted Padic datum [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete] and any degree q, there are a finite stratification and pro-etale covers such that the restricted H^q(K) is F plus N, with F a finite free module sheaf and N admitting a nilpotent endomorphism f. For some quotient index n, cokernel(f) is an epimorphic image of the coefficient-restricted pullback of Tor_1 of H^q(K_(n+1)) for the quotient map R_(n+1) to R_n [prop-weil-pbc-levelwise-truncations]. No Tor vanishing assumption is made.

source.place: DVR model decomposition and torsion-block calculation, proof steps 5--7; separated from flatness descent.

external.place: Tag 0ASV; explicit periodic quotient resolution in the parent proof

proof.text: Choose the finite strata and covering charts supplied by the unlifted-perfect-chart theorem. On each chart obtain its actual perfect valuation-ring value C and local derived isomorphism eC.

Apply the constant-perfect DVR calculation to C and this chart. It supplies r,F,N, a sectionwise basis, a cohomology splitting, nilpotent f and a quotient epimorphism from the Tor sheaf of the completed constant value.

Transport this data along eC. Exact module pullback commutes with homology and with the single functor. Derived scalar extension commutes with pullback: compose its scalar adjunction with the derived geometric adjunction, identify their right adjoints using the ring-sheaf-change direct-image comparison, and use uniqueness of left adjoints. Apply this twice, first to the completed projection and then to the consecutive quotient. Between the two applications take homology in degree q and put it in degree zero. Finally take homology in degree -1 and restrict coefficients. This gives an isomorphism from the actual ambient Tor source to the model Tor source. Compose its hom with the model epimorphism; an isomorphism followed by an epimorphism is epic. Compose the homology comparison with the model splitting to obtain the original conclusion unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Proposition 6.6.11 and Lemma 6.5.8; Lean combines chart extraction and the constant perfect-value DVR calculation using proved homology, single-functor and scalar-extension comparisons.

lean.statement:
theorem pbc_adic_cohomology_torsion_normal_form
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (hl : ∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)) (q : ℤ) :
    let d := pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E
    let B := pbcAdicCompletion T d
    let tor (n : ℕ) := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ (-1)).obj
      ((pbcDerivedExtend (pbcAdicQuotient T d (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n))).obj
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
            ((pbcCompletedReduction T d (n + 1)).obj K.obj))))
    ∃ (S : Stratification T)
      (V : ∀ a : Fin S.n, Cover.{u + 1} proetalePrecoverage (S.domain a)),
      ∀ (a : Fin S.n) (j : (V a).I₀),
        let g := (V a).f j ≫ S.immersion a
        let B' := (adicTowerInverseImage g).obj B
        let P := proEtaleRingModulePullback g B B' (Iso.refl _)
        ∃ (r : ℕ) (F N : pbcModules ((V a).X j) B'),
          (∀ U : ((V a).X j).ProEtᵒᵖ,
            Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin r) (B'.obj.obj U) (F.val.obj U))) ∧
          Nonempty (P.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K.obj) ≅ F ⊞ N) ∧
          ∃ f : End N, IsNilpotent f ∧ ∃ n : ℕ,
            ∃ t : (pbcRestrict ((adicTowerInverseImage g).map
                (pbcAdicProjection T d n))).obj
              ((proEtaleRingModulePullback g ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n))
                ((adicTowerInverseImage g).obj ((pbcAdicRings T d).obj (op n)))
                (Iso.refl _)).obj (tor n)) ⟶ cokernel f,
              Epi t
